task_title: tests/test_lane_target.py stops rebuilding its fixture repo per test (PERF-014)
task_criteria: At the pushed tip: (1) three consecutive runs of 'for i in 1 2 3; do /usr/bin/time -p python3 -B tests/test_lane_target.py; done' report user+sys <= 0.12 s each with the suite reporting OK and 22 tests, the same test count and assertions as 0aadc9e^ (git diff 0aadc9e^ 0aadc9e -- tests/test_lane_target.py is a fixture-sharing refactor, no assertion deleted); (2) 'strace -f -c -e trace=execve python3 -B tests/test_lane_target.py' reports <= 15 successful git execs, down from 38 before the change; (3) 'bash tests/selftest.sh' prints SELFTEST: PASS and still contains every PASS row that existed at 400a5ab (34 of them) plus the rows later commits added; (4) docs/audits/code-factory-perf-2026-11-03-PERF-014.md records both arm numbers, the interleaved A/B pair tables and the exact commands, and names the arms that cannot move without weakening a check.

tier2.summary:
COMPLETE
  ✓ At the pushed tip: (1) three consecutive runs of 'for i in 1 2 3; do /usr/bin/time -p python3 -B tests/test_lane_target.py; done' report user+sys <= 0.12 s each with the suite reporting OK and 22 tests, the same test count and assertions as 0aadc9e^ (git diff 0aadc9e^ 0aadc9e -- tests/test_lane_target.py is a fixture-sharing refactor, no assertion deleted); (2) 'strace -f -c -e trace=execve python3 -B tests/test_lane_target.py' reports <= 15 successful git execs, down from 38 before the change; (3) 'bash tests/selftest.sh' prints SELFTEST: PASS and still contains every PASS row that existed at 400a5ab (34 of them) plus the rows later commits added; (4) docs/audits/code-factory-perf-2026-11-03-PERF-014.md records both arm numbers, the interleaved A/B pair tables and the exact commands, and names the arms that cannot move without weakening a check.: (1) TIMING: 3 runs at tip 9131656 -> user+sys = 0.07+0.03=0.10, 0.07+0.04=0.11, 0.07+0.04=0.11 s (all <=0.12); each printed 'Ran 22 tests in 0.076s / OK'. A second 3-run set gave 0.10/0.11/0.11. Test inventory: `git show 0aadc9e^:tests/test_lane_target.py | grep -c 'def test_'` = 22 vs HEAD = 22; `grep -c 'self\.assert'` = 36 before and 36 after. `git diff 0aadc9e^ 0aadc9e -- tests/test_lane_target.py` shows only setUp->fixture() sharing, black reflow of assertEqual lines (same arguments), and `git remote add origin` replaced by appending the identical [remote "origin"] stanza to .git/config — still proven through git by test_real_checkout_verifies (asserts remotes["origin"] == ORIGIN_URL) and scan's has_remote. No assertion deleted. (2) STRACE: `strace -f -c -e trace=execve python3 -B tests/test_lane_target.py` -> 451 execve calls, 435 errors => 16 successful = 15 git + 1 python3; `strace -f -e trace=execve` breakdown: 15 /usr/bin/git, 0 git-core children (<=15). Before-arm measured by checking out 0aadc9e^'s test file: 33 /usr/bin/git + 5 /usr/lib/git-core/git = 38. (3) SELFTEST: `bash tests/selftest.sh` ends with 'SELFTEST: PASS' and emits 40 PASS rows. Template comparison of `say "  PASS  ..."` strings: 400a5ab has 27 templates, HEAD has 32; `comm -23` (old templates absent at HEAD) is EMPTY, and 5 new templates were added (staged disk floor, missing disk floor, disk floor omitted, reused-agent, $arm failure). All 27 pre-existing rows survive (9 interpolate runtime values, hence the template form). (4) DOC: docs/audits/code-factory-perf-2026-11-03-PERF-014.md (405 lines, tracked) records both arm numbers (0.213 s -> 0.105-0.11 s median 0.105, -46 %; 38 -> 15 git execs), interleaved A/B pair tables (6-rep section-11 new-vs-old median 0.105/0.195; 5-pair whole-gate 1.70/1.74/1.80/1.98/2.00 vs 1.77/2.05/1.88/1.90/1.84; plus an era-1 5-run paired table), the exact commands in a '## Reproduction' block (for-loop, `strace -f -c -e trace=execve`, `strace -f -o` + grep, `git archive` before-tree, mutation recipe, EPOCHREALTIME say() stamper), and a '## Honest floor — what cannot move' section naming the arms that cannot move without weakening a check (fixed ~0.05 s interpreter base, 12 of 15 spawns are the code under test, sharing verification between test_real_checkout_verifies and test_scan_mixed_rows 'would ... remove the only proof that scan actually verifies each local row; that is a weakening, so it was not done', irreducible init+commit), with the per-arm table marking §15 documented-shape arms 'protected: run the documented command unscoped'.
